description: This file defines the Zend_Loader_Autoloader class, implementing an autoloading mechanism for the Zend Framework, including namespace management, version handling, and autoloader stack management.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader
classes.description: Implements a singleton autoloader stack with namespace and version management for Zend Framework classes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the autoloader.

methods.name: resetInstance
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance to null.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Static method to autoload a class using registered autoloaders.

methods.name: setDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Sets the default autoloader callback.

methods.name: getDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Returns the current default autoloader callback.

methods.name: setAutoloaders
methods.description: Sets multiple autoloaders at once.

methods.name: getAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns the list of registered autoloaders.

methods.name: getNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns autoloaders registered for a specific namespace.

methods.name: registerNamespace
methods.description: Registers a namespace for autoloading.

methods.name: unregisterNamespace
methods.description: Unregisters a namespace from autoloading.

methods.name: getRegisteredNamespaces
methods.description: Returns all registered namespace keys.

methods.name: setZfPath
methods.description: Sets the path for a specific Zend Framework version.

methods.name: getZfPath
methods.description: Returns the current Zend Framework path.

methods.name: suppressNotFoundWarnings
methods.description: Gets or sets the flag to suppress warnings for missing files.

methods.name: setFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Sets whether this autoloader acts as a fallback.

methods.name: isFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Checks if this is a fallback autoloader.

methods.name: getClassAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns autoloaders applicable for a class based on namespace.

methods.name: unshiftAutoloader
methods.description: Adds an autoloader to the beginning of the stack.

methods.name: pushAutoloader
methods.description: Adds an autoloader to the end of the stack.

methods.name: removeAutoloader
methods.description: Removes an autoloader from the stack or namespace.

methods.name: _autoload
methods.description: Internal implementation of autoloading logic.

methods.name: _setNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Sets autoloaders for a specific namespace.

methods.name: _getVersionPath
methods.description: Retrieves the filesystem path for a specific Zend Framework version.

methods.name: _getVersionType
methods.description: Determines the type of version string (latest, major, minor, specific).

methods.name: _getAvailableVersions
methods.description: Lists available versions in a directory matching a pattern.
